newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm amid cargo strength.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm amid cargo strength.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes stayed at firm levels on Wednesday amid support in the cargo market, but traders said they saw fewer enquiries than yesterday.

Although the cargo market was boosted by support from a local trader instead of foundamentals, the bunker market followed, traders said. "Some shipowners rushed to buy yesterday on worries that cargo prices may rise further, but not today," said one trader, noting artificial support in the cargo market.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at $98/$100 while MDO and gas oil were quoted at $172/$175 and $184/$186 per tonne respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
